components.description: Medical leave of absence for the faculty member's own health condition (incapacity due to pregnancy included): three consecutive calendar months per condition. For the birth mother it covers disability beyond the six weeks of parental leave.
components.mechanism_note: U6: the policy grants a leave of absence ('medical leave of absence') for the employee's own condition, so the leave is coded here and its pay separately (c7, within it).
components.faculty_group_note: eligible faculty members and academic professional and administrative (P&A) employees; excluded: represented UMD faculty, graduate assistants, civil service and union-represented staff
components.eligible_parent_wording: self needs of eligible faculty members; A physical or mental health condition that prevents employee performance
components.duration_note: 'a total of three consecutive calendar months leave available per physical or mental health condition' (History, October 2008 amendment), consistent with disability benefits starting after 'three months of medical leave'. notes: Governing documents present (the rule for records with no governing document does not apply): 2018_00_link is the Administrative Policy: Parental Leave for Academic Employees (May 2008), covering 'Eligible faculty (94xx)'; its version note says it was superseded on 2018-04-18, after the reference date 2018-03-12, so it was in force. 2018_01 (Regents Faculty Tenure, tenure-clock policy), 2018_03 (paid medical leave) and 2018_04 (FMLA) also govern. 2018_02 (Regents Work-Life and Personal Leaves) is a framework policy listing leave types (bereavement, civic duty, disability, family medical, medical, military, parental, personal, vacation) that 'may be offered and granted' to the extent administrative policies provide; it has no terms of its own and gives no components. Its flexible-work definition ('voluntary reduction in percent time, and job sharing', supported 'If appropriate') is a principle without terms; not a component.

The parental policy excludes 'union-represented faculty and staff employees whose rights are governed by collective bargaining agreements'; the FMLA policy names the represented faculty unit as 'Unit 9 University Education Association (UEA) - UMD and UMC Faculty', so the Minneapolis tenure-stream faculty fall under the policy (faculty_group coded main_campus_tenure_stream).

Cross-references not saved: Administrative Policy: Unpaid Personal Leave for Faculty and P&A Employees (named in 2018_00 for 'extended unpaid leave'); Appendix: Paid Medical Leave Eligibility and Provisions (sets the length of medical leave by appointment); Paid Medical Leave FAQ; Academic Disability Plan document and Academic Long-term Disability Insurance Policy LK-980184; FMLA FAQ and flow chart; Academic Job Codes and Titles; Collective Bargaining Agreements (named in 2018_03 Related Information); Board of Regents Policy: Academic Freedom and Responsibility (quoted in 2018_01).

Medical leave length: the saved text gives 'a total of three consecutive calendar months leave available per physical or mental health condition' only in the policy's History (2008 amendment); the operative text says lengths are in the unsaved Appendix and that disability benefits start after 'three months of medical leave'. Coded 3 months (c6, c7), flagged.

Birth-parent sequence reading (R15): 'To the extent this leave exceeds six weeks for disability, it will be covered under' the Paid Medical Leave policy, so medical leave (c6) is consecutive_after the six-week parental leave (c1). The FAQ adds that the birth mother cannot take more than six weeks of paid medical and parental leave combined 'unless the mother qualifies for additional time under the paid medical leave for her physical recovery'; no leave_limits entry, because the limit falls away exactly where the medical leave applies (flagged on c6). An alternative reading would count the three medical months from the birth with the parental leave inside them.

Chain, birth parent: paid parental leave up to 6 weeks (c1) -> medical leave of absence for disability beyond the six weeks, up to 3 months (c6), with its pay (c7) within it -> long-term disability (c9, no length); FMLA 12 weeks (c10) concurrent from the start of c1, own balances (c11) within FMLA. Tenure-clock extension of one year (c12).

Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave up to 2 weeks (c2) -> unpaid parental leave up to 4 weeks (c3); FMLA 12 weeks (c10) concurrent from the start of c2. Family-care paid medical leave (c8) has no saved length and is unlinked. Tenure-clock extension of one year (c12).
Graduate assistants and postdoctoral associates (c4) and professionals-in-training under a departmental option (c5) are other groups, recorded with their group names.

Not components: Regents tenure 10.1 'Unrequested Leave Of Absence For Disability' (the University may place a faculty member on leave; entitled to sick pay and disability insurance under University policy, right to return) is an involuntary placement, not leave a parent takes; 3.4(k) transfer to term status during degree enrollment; bone marrow or organ donation leave (c6's policy, 40 hours by state statute); the wellness-program scheduling flexibility.

Calendar: 2018_01 refers to 'a single-semester or other paid professional-development leave', which states the kind of term (semester); calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component uses a term unit.

Pay restrictions: parental leave 'must fall within the regular term of appointment' and is without pay in summer session and extension teaching; medical leave pay is not provided when regular pay is not scheduled (appointments under 12 months). Flagged as ambiguous restrictions on c1-c3 and c6.
